page.overview:
Who is Drivetrain?

Drivetrain was a member of the High Council before the beginning of the Great War. He is also a patriarch of the Constructicons and a rare member of the council not to originate from the highest Caste. Instead, Drivetrain originated from the construction-based middle castes. He earned the council's respect through long patience and hard work.

Drivetrain took part in the High Council meeting where Orion Pax was named Optimus Prime. Category:Characters Category:Autobots
